items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Harry was in it and he did a segment and Marge and Gower did a segment

ctx.x: Were they, this is probably, forgive my ignorance but were they white or black?

Oh! Very good question. Marge and Gower were both white. Gower Champion was notably the director for “Hello Dolly,” for many various successful musicals. Marge was a wonderful dancer. She and Gower, I don't know exactly how they met but I know that there was a play called “Three on the Aisle” or … you remember what that is Billie? Anyway, there was … Harry was in it and he did a segment and
Marge and Gower did a segment and somebody else. At any rate, now they were white. Interesting. Interesting that you should ask that.
